text: As required by the City's Investment Policy, the purpose of this report is to provide the Toronto Investment Board with the following: 1. The performance of the Sinking Fund and Long Term Fund for the second quarter of 2022. 2. Investment Policy and Plan Compliance certificates and reports for the second quarter of 2022.
The Toronto Investment Board received the report (August 31, 2022) from the Director, Capital Markets for information.
